title: コンピュータグラフィックス
subtitle: Computer Graphics
educationalGoal: Computer graphics (CG) is used in various fields such as numerical simulations, the visualization of engineering or scientific phenomena, and contents production for education or entertainment use. In addition, output devices such as GPUs and 3D printers have been developed rapidly in recent years. In this course, students will systematically learn the technologies used in CG today. They will also acquire the skills needed to create CG content through programming using a CG library.
advice: In this course, lectures on basic theories about 3D representation and modeling methods are provided, and programming exercises for implementing the theories learned are conducted. Specifically, students will learn and implement knowledge related to coordinate transformation, 3D modeling, hidden surface removal, shading, rendering, texture mapping, and animation in 3D space. Specific topics include the following: 1. Overview of 3D CG technology 2. 3D coordinate system 3. Coordinate and projective transformation in 3D space 4. 3D CG modeling 5. 3D CG animation 6. Overview of 3D CG rendering 7. Hidden surface removal and shading 8. Texture mapping 9. Radiosity and shadowing 10. Summary and reflection
books: Required Materials will be provided in the class.
requiredKnowledge: 1. Students must have basic mathematical skills such as trigonometric functions, matrices, and vector calculations. 2. Student must be able to program an application using C language. Student should spend one hour preparing for the next class or exercise and spend more one hour for reflection.

activityGoals.body: Be able to explain and use coordinate systems in 3D space.
Be able to explain coordinate and projection transformation of 3D CG and use them properly.
Be able to explain the basic methods of 3D modeling and implement them by programming.
Be able to explain hidden surface removal and shading techniques and select effective techniques.
Be able to explain 3D CG animation techniques and program basic animations.

achievementLevels.ideal: Students with ideal achievement will have acquired expert-level knowledge based on the “CG-ARTS CERTIFICATION TEST for CG Engineer”. Specifically, they can explain coordinate systems in 3D space and coordinate transformation. They can also explain basic and advanced 3D modeling. Moreover, they can explain methods of rendering, hidden surface removal, shading, and texture mapping sufficiently, and develop original CG animations using a computer graphics library.
achievementLevels.standard: Students with standard achievement have basic-level knowledge of the “CG-ARTS CERTIFICATION TEST for CG Engineer”. Specifically, they can understand coordinate systems in 3D space and coordinate transformation. They can also explain basic 3D modeling. Moreover, they can explain basic methods of rendering, hidden surface removal, and shading, and develop primitive CG animation using sample programs of computer graphics library.

lessons.content: Learn the overview of 3D computer graphics. In addition, students will install the computer graphics programming environment on their personal notebook PCs.
lessons.assignments: Prepare the programming environment and understand the overview of 3D computer graphics. Prepare 3D coordinate system and geometric transformation system.

lessons.content: Learn 3D coordinate systems such as World, local coordinate systems, and 3D geometric transformations such as Modeling transformation, Viewing transformation, and Projection transformation.
lessons.assignments: Review and understand the 3D coordinate system and perform several transformations by executing the exercises. Prepare basic 3D modeling.

lessons.content: Learn several 3D modeling methods such as Wireframe model, Surface model, Free-form surface, and CSG representation, etc.
lessons.assignments: Review and understand 3D modeling by performing the exercises. Prepare more complex 3D modeling.

lessons.content: Learn complex 3D modeling such as fractal, particle, and voxel representations.
lessons.assignments: Review complex 3D modeling and prepare the non-objective modeling. In addition, continue work on CG animation programming.

lessons.content: Learn non-objective modeling such as lights, background, and sound sources.
lessons.assignments: Review non-objective modeling and prepare computer graphics animation. In addition, continue work on CG animation programming

lessons.content: Learn CG animation methods such as the key frame method, kinematics, motion blur, etc. In addition, learn the hardware such as the GPU and 3D printer.
lessons.assignments: Reflect all learning topics in the first half of this class. Complete the first CG animation programming.

lessons.content: Mid-term reflection: understand all the topics learned in the first half of this class deeply. Take the test to verify comprehension.
lessons.operation: Test or quizzes, exercise, and self-check
lessons.assignments: Prepare the overview of the topics (rendering, shading, texture mapping, etc.) in the last half of this class.

lessons.content: Learn the overview of rendering (photo realistic rendering, non-photo realistic rendering, volume rendering, etc.).
lessons.assignments: Review the basic rendering method through the exercise and prepare to study hidden surface removal.

lessons.content: Learn hidden surface removal methods such as the Z-buffer method and scan line method.
lessons.assignments: Review hidden surface removal method through the exercise and prepare to study shading methods.

lessons.content: Learn shading methods such as Gouraud shading and Phong shading.
lessons.assignments: Review shading methods through the calculating in actual cases and prepare to study texture mapping. In addition, continue work on CG animation programming.

lessons.content: Learn texture mapping methods such as wrap mapping and UV mapping.
lessons.assignments: Review texture mapping methods and prepare to study radiosity method and shadowing. In addition, continue work on CG animation programming.
Review radiosity method and shadowing and proceed CG animation programming.

lessons.content: Final reflection: understand all the topics learned in the last half of this class deeply and complete CG animation programming.
lessons.assignments: Review the all learning topics in the last half of this class for the final exam.

lessons.content: Take a test to make sure all learning topics in the last half of this class.
lessons.assignments: Complete CG animation programming, if necessary.

lessons.content: Self-evaluation class: Confirm the level of understanding of computer graphics and discuss future research.
lessons.assignments: Review the topics learned in this class once again, and connect them for future studies and research.
